source_en: New form. The spacing changed. Shorena Maisuradze, schoolteacher, twenty-two years.
My daughters are waiting on the fourth floor. I said I'd be [[whisper:back before dark]].
Tamara's twelve, argues everything. Nana's nine, accepts too much.
They're afraid and hiding it. I pretend not to notice.
School's closed. My students are scattered over four shelters. I still send work.
One of three, last week. One is enough to keep going.
Children fall apart without structure. Adults too. So, yes.
